% Pattern: proof/amsthm/article. A proof that names its statement with \ref
% (rule 1), and a proof of a part of a statement.
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1 status=here labels=lem:key
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 2 status=here labels=thm:main
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1 part=(b)
% want proof-2 proof - proves=lemma-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma}\label{lem:key}
The key lemma.
\end{lemma}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main}
The main result.
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(a)] The first part.\label{thm:main:a}
\item[(b)] The second part.\label{thm:main:b}
\end{enumerate}
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:main:b}]
The second part.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}[Proof of Lemma \ref{lem:key}]
The key step.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
